documents.title: NanoStream Brochure 2025
documents.scope: NanoStreamS/T/V source family; MSF mass filter; NanoShell optional accessory; full system examples SH300 and NC400; also depicts third-party Korvus Technology HEXL.
documents.model_evidence: Page 3 names NanoStreamS (1 head), NanoStreamT (3 head), NanoStreamV (5 head). Page 4 names SH300 and NC400. Page 6 gives NanoStreamS/T/V and MSF specifications.
caveats: The NanoShell section on page 4 directs readers to ask Theris for a dedicated NanoShell brochure; a dedicated file was not linked on the reviewed product page.
Do not ingest HEXL as a Theris model: the brochure labels it KORVUS TECHNOLOGY.
MSF mass-range exponent is corrupted on the webpage. Brochure page 6 shows 2â€“10^8 amu; do not copy webpage's apparent 10 amu.

findings: Suitable true photographs are available for the SH300 full system, SMPL stage family, and RF-ion family details. NanoStream, NanoShell, MSF and TAS30/TAS60 webpage equipment assets are renders.
No public prices were found in the reviewed sources; leave numeric prices empty.
Ion and SMPL brochure links are mismatched atom brochures. NanoShell uses the general NanoStream brochure, not a dedicated NanoShell technical file.
Exact standalone NC400 image URL was not established in this bounded review; its name is verified in the linked brochure.

limits: No independent adoption prevalence or incorporation date inferred from the owner confirmation.
No numeric price or estimate anchor invented; the reviewed sources have no public numeric price.
Technical web pages and brochures are not operating manuals. RF-ion and stage brochure mislinks are excluded.
Accessories and neutral/ion species remain distinct from complete deposition systems. Existing process-step requirements are unchanged.
No exact NC400 image adopted. Other imagery retains render/detail/family scopes.
Korvus HEXL is not a Theris-manufactured model and is not imported as one.
